disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMO DATA. All insurers, policy names, numbers and clause wordings are fictitious and created for a hackathon prototype. They are not real insurance contracts.

policies.name: Family Floater Shield
policies.summary: Family floater covering hospitalisation for self, spouse and son. Cashless at network hospitals.

clauses.title: In-patient hospitalisation
clauses.text: Covers medically necessary in-patient treatment for a minimum of 24 consecutive hours, including room, ICU, surgeon and anaesthetist fees, medicines and diagnostics, up to the sum insured.

clauses.title: Cashless at network hospitals
clauses.text: Cashless treatment is available at network hospitals. Planned admissions need pre-authorisation 48 hours before admission; emergency admissions must be intimated within 24 hours.

clauses.title: Network hospitals (Pune)
clauses.text: Cashless network hospitals in Pune (simulated list): Riverside Multispeciality, Greenfield General. Other hospitals: reimbursement only.

clauses.title: Pre and post hospitalisation
clauses.text: Medical expenses incurred 30 days before and 60 days after a covered hospitalisation are payable.

clauses.title: Day care procedures
clauses.text: Listed day care procedures that need less than 24 hours in hospital because of medical technology (for example cataract surgery, chemotherapy, dialysis and lithotripsy) are covered up to the sum insured.

clauses.title: Ambulance
clauses.text: Road ambulance charges up to ₹3,000 per hospitalisation.

clauses.title: Mental illness
clauses.text: In-patient treatment for mental illness at a recognised psychiatric or general hospital is covered like any other illness, up to the sum insured. Outpatient therapy and counselling are not covered.

clauses.title: Room rent
clauses.text: Room category up to a single private room. If a higher category is chosen, associated expenses are paid proportionately.

clauses.title: Cataract sub-limit
clauses.text: Cataract treatment is limited to ₹40,000 per eye per policy year.

clauses.title: Initial waiting period
clauses.text: Illnesses contracted within the first 30 days of the first policy are not covered, except accidents. The first policy (with the earlier insurer, ported in) started 2023-07-01.

clauses.title: Pre-existing diseases
clauses.text: Pre-existing diseases declared at proposal are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. Current continuous coverage started 2023-07-01 (prior insurer porting included).

clauses.title: Maternity
clauses.text: Maternity expenses are covered after a waiting period of 24 months, counted from 2026-07-01 when the benefit was added (the earlier insurer had no maternity cover, so no credit carries over), up to ₹50,000 per delivery.

clauses.title: Specific illnesses (24 months)
clauses.text: Cataract, hernia, hydrocele, gallbladder and kidney stones, piles and fistula, sinus and tonsil surgery, varicose veins, benign prostate enlargement and hysterectomy are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, counted from 2023-07-01 (prior insurer porting included), unless caused by an accident.

clauses.title: Joint replacement (48 months)
clauses.text: Joint replacement surgery (knee or hip), unless needed because of an accident, is covered after 48 months of continuous coverage, counted from 2023-07-01.

clauses.title: Dental exclusion
clauses.text: Dental treatment is excluded unless it requires hospitalisation due to an accidental injury.

clauses.title: Cosmetic and OPD
clauses.text: Cosmetic procedures, outpatient consultations and spectacles are excluded.

clauses.title: Non-medical items
clauses.text: Non-medical items such as admission kits, toiletries, gloves, masks and attendant charges are not payable.

clauses.title: Self-inflicted injury and substance abuse
clauses.text: Treatment for intentional self-inflicted injury, alcohol or drug abuse, and injuries from hazardous or adventure sports is excluded.

clauses.title: Disclosure of health conditions
clauses.text: Cover is issued on the basis of the proposal form. If a pre-existing condition or other material fact was not disclosed, the insurer may reject related claims and cancel the policy. After 60 months of continuous coverage, counted from 2023-07-01, no claim can be contested for non-disclosure except for proven fraud.

clauses.title: How to claim
clauses.text: Cashless: show the health card at the network hospital TPA desk. Reimbursement: submit claim form, discharge summary, bills, prescriptions and reports within 30 days of discharge.

clauses.title: Claim intimation and deadlines
clauses.text: Emergency admissions: intimate the insurer within 24 hours of admission. Planned admissions: request pre-authorisation 48 hours before. Reimbursement documents within 30 days of discharge; post-hospitalisation bills within 15 days of completing that treatment. Delays may be condoned if the reason is explained in writing.

clauses.title: Adding family members
clauses.text: Spouse, children or parents can be added at renewal, subject to a proposal form and medical underwriting; waiting periods start afresh for each new member. A newborn can be added within 90 days of birth.

clauses.title: Portability
clauses.text: You may port this policy to another insurer at renewal by applying at least 45 days before the renewal date. Waiting periods already served carry over up to the existing sum insured.

clauses.title: Renewal and grace period
clauses.text: Renew by 2027-06-30. A 30-day grace period keeps continuity (waiting-period credit is not lost), but treatment taken while the premium is unpaid is not covered. If not renewed within the grace period, the policy lapses and waiting periods restart.

clauses.title: Grievances and Ombudsman
clauses.text: If a claim is rejected or short-settled, write to the Grievance Officer (grievance desk 1800-000-0102); a reply is due within 14 days. If unresolved after 30 days, complain through IRDAI Bima Bharosa or to the Insurance Ombudsman within 1 year of the insurer’s final reply (claims up to ₹50 lakh).

policies.name: Employer Group Health
policies.summary: Employer-provided group cover including dependent parents. Premium paid by employer.

clauses.title: Hospitalisation cover
clauses.text: Covers in-patient hospitalisation for the employee and enrolled dependants, including dependent parents, up to the family sum insured.

clauses.title: Day-one pre-existing cover
clauses.text: Pre-existing diseases and the 30-day initial waiting period are waived for all enrolled members.

clauses.title: Group waiver of waiting periods
clauses.text: As a group policy, the initial, pre-existing, specific-illness and maternity waiting periods do not apply to enrolled members.

clauses.title: Network hospitals (Pune)
clauses.text: Cashless network hospitals in Pune (simulated list): Lotus Heart Institute, Riverside Multispeciality, Sahyadri Care Hospital. Other hospitals: reimbursement only.

clauses.title: Maternity benefit
clauses.text: Maternity covered from day one up to ₹75,000 per delivery.

clauses.title: Cashless network
clauses.text: Cashless facility at empanelled hospitals through the TPA. Emergency admissions must be intimated to the TPA within 24 hours.

clauses.title: Day care procedures
clauses.text: Listed day care procedures needing less than 24 hours in hospital (for example cataract surgery, chemotherapy and dialysis) are covered up to the family sum insured.

clauses.title: Pre and post hospitalisation
clauses.text: Medical expenses incurred 30 days before and 60 days after a covered hospitalisation are payable.

clauses.title: Co-payment for parents
clauses.text: Claims for dependent parents carry a 20% co-payment on the admissible claim amount.

clauses.title: Room rent limit
clauses.text: Room rent is capped at 1% of sum insured per day (₹5,000) and ICU at 2% (₹10,000). Higher rooms lead to proportionate deduction.

clauses.title: Cardiac procedures sub-limit
clauses.text: Angioplasty and bypass procedures are limited to ₹3,00,000 per policy year.

clauses.title: Cataract sub-limit
clauses.text: Cataract treatment is limited to ₹25,000 per eye per policy year.

clauses.title: Coverage ends with employment
clauses.text: Cover ends on the last working day of the employee. Conversion to an individual policy may be offered within 30 days.

clauses.title: Group enrolment and disclosure
clauses.text: Members are enrolled through the employer without individual medical underwriting, so there is no health questionnaire on which conditions had to be declared. Claims can still be rejected for false information in the claim itself.

clauses.title: Adding dependants
clauses.text: A new spouse or newborn can be added within 30 days of marriage or birth. Parents and parents-in-law can be added only during the annual enrolment window in March through the HR portal, with cover starting 1 April.

clauses.title: Dental exclusion
clauses.text: Dental treatment is excluded unless arising from an accident requiring hospitalisation.

clauses.title: Cosmetic, OPD and spectacles
clauses.text: Cosmetic procedures, outpatient consultations, spectacles and contact lenses are excluded.

clauses.title: Non-medical items
clauses.text: Non-medical items such as admission kits, toiletries, gloves, masks and attendant charges are not payable.

clauses.title: How to claim
clauses.text: Intimate the TPA via the HR portal or helpline. Submit discharge summary, final bill, ID proof of the patient and employee ID within 30 days of discharge.

clauses.title: Claim deadlines
clauses.text: Planned admissions need pre-authorisation through the TPA at least 72 hours before admission. Emergency admissions must be intimated within 24 hours. Late intimation or submission may be accepted if the delay is explained in writing.

clauses.title: Grievances and Ombudsman
clauses.text: Raise a rejected or short-settled claim with the HR benefits desk and the insurer’s Grievance Officer; a reply is due within 14 days. If unresolved after 30 days, complain through IRDAI Bima Bharosa or to the Insurance Ombudsman within 1 year of the insurer’s final reply (claims up to ₹50 lakh).

policies.name: Car Secure Comprehensive
policies.summary: Comprehensive car cover with zero depreciation and roadside assistance add-ons.

clauses.title: Own damage
clauses.text: Covers loss or damage to the insured vehicle from accident, fire, theft, flood and other listed perils.

clauses.title: Glass damage
clauses.text: Accidental damage to windshield and window glass is covered. Glass-only claims are settled without depreciation and do not affect the no-claim bonus under this simulated policy.

clauses.title: Compulsory deductible
clauses.text: A compulsory deductible of ₹1,000 applies to every own-damage claim, including glass claims.

clauses.title: Zero depreciation add-on
clauses.text: Depreciation on replaced plastic, rubber, fibre and metal parts is waived for up to 2 claims per policy year. Without this add-on, depreciation of 30-50% would apply to such parts.

clauses.title: Roadside assistance
clauses.text: 24x7 roadside assistance for breakdown, towing up to 50 km, flat tyre and battery jump-start.

clauses.title: General exclusions
clauses.text: Not covered: driving under influence of alcohol or drugs, driving without a valid licence, normal wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, and use for racing.

clauses.title: Engine damage from water
clauses.text: Consequential engine damage from driving through water (hydrostatic lock) is excluded as engine protection add-on is not opted.

clauses.title: How to claim
clauses.text: Inform the insurer within 48 hours. Do not repair before survey. Keep photos of damage, RC, driving licence and policy copy. Cashless repair available at network garages.

policies.name: Globetrot Annual Multi-Trip
policies.summary: Annual multi-trip travel cover, worldwide excluding USA and Canada, trips up to 45 days each.

clauses.title: Emergency medical abroad
clauses.text: Emergency medical treatment while travelling abroad up to ₹85,00,000, including hospitalisation and emergency evacuation.

clauses.title: Geographical scope
clauses.text: Cover applies worldwide excluding the USA and Canada.

clauses.title: Trip duration and policy period
clauses.text: Each trip must not exceed 45 days and must start and end within the policy period (16 Dec 2025 to 15 Dec 2026). Days after expiry are not covered.

clauses.title: Trip cancellation
clauses.text: Non-refundable trip costs up to ₹2,50,000 if the trip is cancelled due to death or serious illness of the insured or immediate family.

clauses.title: Baggage delay
clauses.text: Essential purchases up to ₹17,000 if checked baggage is delayed more than 12 hours. Total loss of baggage up to ₹85,000.

clauses.title: Flight delay
clauses.text: ₹4,000 for every 6 hours of delay, maximum ₹25,000.

clauses.title: Adventure sports exclusion
clauses.text: Injuries from adventure sports including skiing, snowboarding, scuba diving and high-altitude trekking above 3,000 m are excluded.

clauses.title: Pre-existing conditions
clauses.text: Treatment of pre-existing conditions abroad is excluded except life-threatening emergencies, up to ₹4,25,000.

clauses.title: How to claim
clauses.text: Call the 24x7 assistance line before hospital admission abroad where possible. Submit claim within 30 days of return with passport copy, boarding passes, bills and medical reports.

policies.name: Secure Term Plus
policies.summary: Pure term life cover of ₹1 crore till age 65. Nominee: Meera Mehta.

clauses.title: Death benefit
clauses.text: On death of the life assured during the policy term, the sum assured of ₹1,00,00,000 is payable to the nominee.

clauses.title: Accidental death rider
clauses.text: An additional ₹25,00,000 is payable if death results from an accident within 180 days of the accident.

clauses.title: Worldwide cover
clauses.text: The death benefit is payable wherever death occurs, in India or abroad. For a death abroad, the death certificate must be attested by the Indian embassy or consulate.

clauses.title: Suicide exclusion
clauses.text: Suicide within 12 months of the policy start or revival: 80% of premiums paid are refunded instead of the sum assured.

clauses.title: Accidental death rider exclusions
clauses.text: The accidental death rider is not payable for death due to self-inflicted injury, intoxication by alcohol or drugs, hazardous or adventure sports, taking part in a criminal act, or war. The base death benefit is unaffected.

clauses.title: No critical illness benefit
clauses.text: This policy does not include a critical illness or hospitalisation benefit. Only death (and accidental death under the rider) is covered.

clauses.title: Disclosure and Section 45
clauses.text: The policy was issued on the proposal form (declared: non-smoker, no medical history). Under Section 45 of the Insurance Act, 1938, the insurer can question the policy for fraud or misstatement of material facts only within 3 years from the date of issue or revival, counted from 2021-08-06; after that it cannot be called in question on any ground.

clauses.title: Grace period
clauses.text: A 30-day grace period applies for annual premiums. Cover lapses if premium is unpaid after the grace period.

clauses.title: Revival after lapse
clauses.text: A lapsed policy can be revived within 5 years of the first unpaid premium by paying all arrears with interest and giving health evidence if asked. Revival restarts the 12-month suicide clause and the 3-year Section 45 period.

clauses.title: Nomination
clauses.text: Nominee: Meera Mehta (spouse), 100%. The nomination can be changed at any time during the policy term by a written endorsement request (Section 39 of the Insurance Act); the latest registered nomination applies.

clauses.title: How to claim
clauses.text: Nominee submits the claim form, death certificate, policy document, nominee ID and bank details. Additional documents may be required for accidental death.

clauses.title: Claim settlement timeline
clauses.text: Intimate the claim as soon as possible after death. The insurer settles within 15 days of receiving all documents, or within 45 days if an investigation is needed.

clauses.title: Grievances and Ombudsman
clauses.text: If a death claim is rejected, the nominee can write to the Grievance Officer (claims desk 1800-000-0404); a reply is due within 14 days. If unresolved after 30 days, complain through IRDAI Bima Bharosa or to the Insurance Ombudsman within 1 year of the insurer’s final reply (claims up to ₹50 lakh); larger claims go to the consumer commission or court.

policies.name: Home Shield Plus
policies.summary: Home building and contents cover against fire, flood, theft and burglary.

clauses.title: Fire and allied perils
clauses.text: Covers damage to the building and contents from fire, lightning, explosion, storm, flood and inundation.

clauses.title: Burglary and theft
clauses.text: Covers contents lost to burglary or theft involving forcible entry, up to ₹5,00,000. Jewellery is limited to ₹1,00,000.

clauses.title: Water leakage
clauses.text: Accidental damage from bursting or overflowing of water tanks and pipes is covered. Gradual seepage is not covered.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.text: ₹5,000 deductible applies to every claim.

clauses.title: Earthquake not opted
clauses.text: Earthquake damage is excluded because the earthquake add-on was not opted.

clauses.title: General exclusions
clauses.text: Wear and tear, gradual seepage, mould, and electrical or mechanical breakdown are excluded. Theft while the home is unoccupied for more than 60 days is excluded.

clauses.title: How to claim
clauses.text: Inform the insurer within 7 days. For theft or burglary file a police FIR. Keep photos, purchase invoices and repair estimates.

policies.name: Personal Accident Guard
policies.summary: Accident-only cover for death, disability and accident hospital expenses.

clauses.title: Accidental death and disability
clauses.text: Pays 100% of sum insured for accidental death or permanent total disability, and a scale percentage for permanent partial disability.

clauses.title: Accident medical expenses
clauses.text: Medical expenses following an accident up to ₹1,00,000 per policy year, in addition to any health policy.

clauses.title: Temporary total disability
clauses.text: ₹10,000 per week for up to 52 weeks if an accident prevents the insured from working.

clauses.title: Exclusions
clauses.text: Illness or disease (including cardiac events not caused by accident), self-inflicted injury, intoxication and adventure sports are excluded.

clauses.title: How to claim
clauses.text: Inform within 30 days of the accident with claim form, medical reports and FIR or accident report where applicable.
